optimizedDescription.value: Abstract skill storage contract: lists skills/shared files and resolves template bundles with config and shared provenance.

optimizedContext.value:
# Skill Repository Port

## Rules
- `SkillRepositoryPort`: `list(): Skill[]`; `get(name): Skill|undefined`; `getBundle(name, variables?: Record<string,string>, config?: SpecdConfig): SkillBundle`; `listSharedFiles(): SharedFile[]`.
- `getBundle` accepts `SpecdConfig` for built-in template variable injection. Files from `listSharedFiles()` retain `shared:true`; skill-local files never marked shared.

## Constraints
- Abstract port only; no I/O. Concrete fs implementations are infrastructure.
